fields.title: 5. Probability and Value — No Change
fields.md:
- No probability adjustment rules R1–R6 were met — the 25/50/25 scenarios stand (source: state.probability_adjustment_rules).
- Assumed value band $265.0–$684.5 · probability-weighted $469.6 · base $464.4 — unchanged from the first round (formula and sources in the valuation section of the [2026-11 report](2026-11.md)).
- Price update (close): Class B share $586.76 (2026-11-17, [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/brk.b/history/)) — −1.0% from the previous day (formula 586.76 ÷ 592.85 − 1), 26.3% above the base present value (formula 586.76 ÷ 464.4 − 1). With the exit P/B fixed at 1.45x, the implied BPS compounding is 10.6% (formula (586.76 × 2.411 ÷ (357.73 × 1.45))^(1/10) − 1).
- Market cap about $1,248.8 billion (formula 586.76 × 1,418,900 × 1,500) − net cash $356.9 billion − equities $335.5 billion = value placed on the operating businesses about $556.4 billion → 14.6 times annualized after-tax operating earnings excluding investment income of $38.08 billion (formula 556,370 ÷ 38,080, same approximation as the first round).
- This probe does not judge any causal link between the donation disclosure and the share price (judgment) — a one-day −1.0% is not material for the event round's assessment.
